commits.subject: fix(scorecard): handle assisted groundout credits (5-3, 6-3, etc.)
commits.body:
_extract_fielder_position only checked f_fielded_ball credits, which
are used for fly outs and unassisted plays. Assisted groundouts use
f_assist + f_putout credits instead, so groundouts showed "G?" on
the dashboard. Now checks f_fielded_ball first, then f_assist.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(scorecard): handle f_putout credit for fly outs
commits.body:
MLB API uses f_putout (not f_fielded_ball) for some routine fly outs.
Priority chain is now: f_fielded_ball > f_assist > f_putout, so
groundouts still show the assist fielder (6-3 → G6, not G3).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
